tool_args.rationale: A two-state relaxation model explains the history gap by reconstructing the latent memory from the actual irregular time intervals. With an analytic forecast equivalent to the submitted RK4 model, the eight paid rows gave a fit RMSE of about 0.000007 and maximum leave-one-out error below 0.000024. Submit for fresh confirmation without another purchase.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fits the paid rows within tolerance but cannot distinguish matched endpoints with different histories. The coupled model also fits these rows substantially better.
The ambiguity concerned transient memory, not a sink-gradient branch. The eight available trajectories cover both upward and downward input steps near the target horizon.
The acquired batch already supports a four-parameter fit with leave-one-out errors far below tolerance.
